name: Trial merge a run's branch
description: In the repository's own checkout, stages the merge of a run's result branch onto the base branch and writes its commit message; the run then checks the merged tree and commits it, or aborts it.
examples: Use this when a run is finished and a person has approved what it made.

name: Say why it aborted
description: When the merge conflicts or anything else goes wrong before it signs off, aborts the merge and reports what stopped it, so the work can be sent back rather than half-shipped.
examples: Use this when an ending must be safe to run unattended.
